description: DiligenceOps: submit attributed quotes or endorsements and the source material. The signed report marks each attribution as matching, differing or without a source, comparing the wording word by word (verbatim, with elisions, or a close version with the differing words) and checking that the attributed person, role and organization appear with the passage. POST /api/testimonial-evidence-check. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. The report matches words, figures, dates and named items between the submitted texts; it does not interpret meaning beyond that matching. Contract: /api/diligence-terms-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

attributions.description: Up to 50 quotes or endorsements with the person or organization they are attributed to.

attributed_to.description: The person or organization it is attributed to.

id.description: Optional reference, recorded in the report.

quote.description: The quote or endorsement as published.

role.description: Optional role or title published with it.

format.description: html reduces the markup to readable text first. Defaults to html when the text starts with a tag, otherwise text.

sources.description: The source material: transcripts, reviews, articles or messages, as text or up to 200 excerpts as {source, text}. Up to 256 KB in all.

name: wever_testimonial-evidence-check
title: Testimonial evidence check
